name: tusella
description: Work on your Etsy shop's listings in Tusella from a conversation. Changes are saved as drafts; you publish in Tusella.

interface.longDescription:
Tusella is a workspace for Etsy sellers. Connect it to work on your own shop's listings from a conversation.

Ask about your shop: how many listings are active, which have unpublished changes, the available details of a listing and how it differs from what is live on Etsy.

Ask for changes: edit titles, tags, descriptions and prices on one listing or many, arrange photos, create a new listing or copy an existing one. Changes stay in Tusella until you publish. Recover journaled edits when undo is available; photo changes use supported inverse actions.

Nothing is published from the conversation. When you are ready, ask for a review and open the link: you confirm publishing yourself in Tusella.

Requires a Tusella account with a connected Etsy shop.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my shop and what needs attention.
Find my listings with unpublished changes and summarize what changed.
Prepare a review of my changes so I can publish them in Tusella.

positive.description: Discover the connected team and choose a shop before its overview.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my shop.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the authorized team and its shops first. Ask which shop if ambiguous; then report returned status counts and unpublished-change counts without claiming a complete listing inventory.

positive.description: Find listings by a seller-facing fact.
positive.prompt: Find my active listings with "walnut" in the title.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer lists the matching listings by title and does not ask the seller for an internal id.

positive.description: Read one listing and compare it with Etsy.
positive.prompt: Show me the Walnut Desk Tray listing and what differs from Etsy.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the listing, report the returned fields and comparison with current Etsy evidence, and disclose any truncation or unavailable coverage. Do not claim a fresh Etsy observation. Exact description access requires a completed exact content chain; preview or partial content supplies no full-text or description write coverage.

positive.description: Edit one listing as a draft and prepare the change for the seller to publish.
positive.prompt: Add the tag "valet tray" to that listing and prepare the change for publishing.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve and read the target, add the tag as a draft only with granted write access, and report the actual receipt. Nothing changes on Etsy. Return the review URL if review creation succeeds; explain readiness or access refusals truthfully. The seller confirms publishing in Tusella; nothing is published by the tool.

Use the recovery_ref returned for the journaled edit. Inspect a deferred operation when returned and report its real outcome. Explain unavailable or conflicting recovery rather than promising success. Nothing changes on Etsy.

negative.description: Publishing is the seller's own confirmation in Tusella. The plugin has no publish tool, so it explains this and may offer to prepare a review instead.
negative.prompt: Publish my changes to Etsy right now.

negative.description: The plugin works only on the seller's own shop. It has no access to other shops or to Etsy search, so no tool is called.
negative.prompt: Show me the best-selling walnut serving boards from other Etsy shops.

negative.description: The plugin has no tool that deletes a listing. It declines and changes nothing.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and edit your Etsy shop's listings in Tusella as drafts, and prepare a review to publish in Tusella.
